references.text: The Lord your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, just as he did in Egypt before your eyes
Do not be afraid of them, for the Lord your God fights for you
For the Lord your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies and to give you victory
The Lord will fight for you, and you shall hold your peace
The Lord fought for Israel by sending hail upon their enemies
All these kings and their lands Joshua took at one time, because the Lord, the God of Israel, fought for Israel
The people confess that they have seen all that the Lord did, and that he drove out the nations before them
The Lord will drive out many nations before Israel
The Lord gave Israel victory over the Amorites and their kings
